Let me check that. What is the cart value, and which device are you on?
Around 589 rupees, and I am on an Android phone. My wife tried the same code on her iPhone and it worked fine.
That is a very useful detail, thank you. Let me confirm something on my side.

You are right that the cart qualifies. I am applying the 177 rupee discount to your account manually so you are not blocked, and I am raising this with our engineering team as a device-specific issue.

That is a fair point and I am putting exactly that in the report. The credit is on your account now, you can place the order whenever you like.
Thank you for flagging it. Have a good day.
